__mixed: An extreme macro of a single human iris filling the whole portrait frame -- a warm brown-amber Singaporean eye whose silky stromal fibres radiate like jewel-inlaid spokes from a crisp, perfectly round jet-black pupil, threaded with glints of hazel and green near the collarette and encircled by a clean dark limbal ring. Every crypt, contraction furrow and fine radial fibre is rendered in dewy, luminous detail under rich soft light, the moist corneal sheen catching a single soft crisp highlight, deeply inviting and premium, with no instruments or hands anywhere in view.
anatomy_physiology: A large cross-sectioned anatomical model of the human eyeball dominates the portrait frame, sliced open to show the clear domed cornea at the front, the coloured iris ring and round black pupil, the crystalline lens just behind it, the wide jelly-filled vitreous chamber, the reddish-orange retina lining the curved inner back wall, and the pale optic nerve exiting the rear; slim metal pointer lines fan out cleanly to each structure with blank markers only. A young Singaporean-Chinese anatomy instructor in plain solid blue scrubs steadies the model with one hand, mid-explanation, softly out of focus behind it, under bright clean teaching-lab lighting.
microbiology_infection: A round agar culture plate held up in a blue-gloved hand fills the foreground, its warm amber gel swept with fanning zig-zag streak-for-isolation lines and studded with crisp creamy-white and pale-gold bacterial colonies, sharp and unmistakable. Just behind, a colleague's bare, ungloved hands rub a bead of clear alcohol gel between interlaced fingers in correct hand-hygiene technique over a bright stainless clinical bench. A Singaporean Chinese staff member is softly focused deeper in frame while the hand-rub is performed by an Indian colleague, two staff of different ethnicities in blue scrubs under cool bright light, clean infection-control mood.
pharmacology: A tight, slightly overhead portrait view of numerous slim ophthalmic eye-drop dropper bottles standing in neat clustered groups on a clean white clinical dispensary counter, sorted by boldly distinct colour-coded caps - a group of teal caps beside groups of warm orange, sunny yellow, deep red, sky blue and forest green - each colour plainly marking a different class of eye medication so the whole array reads as a colour-sorted drug system at a single glance, the fine dropper nozzles and clear-and-frosted bottle bodies unmistakably eye drops. Soft natural clinic light glints off the plastic, with a warm out-of-focus Singapore eye-clinic dispensary and the gloved hand of a Singaporean pharmacy staff member reaching in to select one bottle in the blurred background.
ocular_emergencies: An extreme macro close-up filling the portrait frame with one acutely painful, inflamed human eye showing the textbook signs of a true sight-threatening emergency: intensely engorged deep-red vessels crowded into a violet-red ring hugging the limbus around the iris (ciliary flush), a dull, cloudy, hazy cornea that has lost its clear mirror-like shine from swelling, and a mid-dilated, oval, fixed pupil glimpsed dimly through the haze. A glassy film of tears wells at the lid margin with one tear tracking over flushed skin under warm, even clinical light; behind the dominant emergency-red eye a Singaporean adult's face sits in soft focus, brow tensed and fingertips hovering near the temple in evident pain.
professional_ethics: A young Malay allied-health eye-care clinician in plain solid blue scrubs leans in with genuine, unhurried attention across a small consultation desk, holding warm trusting eye contact and resting a gentle, reassuring hand beside the calmly folded hands of an elderly Chinese patient, their faces close in shared understanding. The two sit alone in a hushed, curtained private consultation booth of a Singapore eye clinic -- a slit-lamp instrument softly blurred far in the background -- bathed in warm natural window light that radiates dignity, confidentiality and respectful, empathetic care. Portrait framing, close and intimate, the tender human connection filling and dominating the frame.
disorders_eyelid_lacrimal_orbit: An extreme macro of a middle-aged Malay woman's eye filling the frame, dominated by a swollen, red, tender, pointing lump sitting right at the lash line on the lower lid margin -- a classic stye (external hordeolum) -- with the surrounding lid skin inflamed and taut around it. Held in equally sharp focus at the inner corner is the tiny raised opening of the lower lacrimal punctum on the lid margin, just beside the small pink fleshy caruncle, glistening with tear film. Warm, bright, even clinical lighting rakes across the individual lashes, the angry red swelling, and the moist inner canthus in crisp, detailed relief.
disorders_cornea_conjunctiva: An extreme macro of a young Singaporean patient's wide-open eye during a slit-lamp examination, where a bright, narrow blade of crisp white light strikes at a sharp 45-degree angle and carves a glowing optical cross-section cleanly through the transparent, curved layers of the clear cornea. The beam edge-lights the corneal dome like glass while revealing the gleaming white sclera beside it and the fine red vessels threading the moist, glistening conjunctiva in razor-sharp detail, with a warm brown iris softly lit behind. Natural and unposed, brightly and professionally lit.
disorders_lens_cataract: Extreme macro of a warm brown elderly Singaporean-Chinese eye filling the frame, its dark iris ring staying sharp and richly coloured while the round pupil aperture is completely filled by a dense, frosted milky-white and amber opacity -- a mature cataract reading as a solid pale-and-golden clouding seen through the pupil. Soft raking clinical light catches crisp lashes and natural crinkled skin, so the opaque, clouded pupil is unmistakably a cataract; a calm, unposed expression.
disorders_uvea_retina: A single large circular retinal fundus view dominates the frame -- a warm orange-red retina with a pale optic disc off to one side, but unmistakably DISEASED: a creamy pale-yellow focal chorioretinal lesion with dark pigmented margins beside the macula (active posterior uveitis / chorioretinitis), a few scattered dark retinal haemorrhages, short stretches of vessel sheathed in white, and a faint haze of overlying vitreous inflammation, so it clearly reads as a uvea-and-retina disorder rather than a healthy eye. Softly out of focus to one side, a young Singaporean Chinese ophthalmic technician in plain solid blue scrubs leans in to study the diseased fundus, warm bright clinic light.
glaucoma: A magnified circular retinal fundus view dominates the frame -- a luminous orange-red retina threaded with branching vessels that converge on a large, central optic disc whose cup is strikingly wide, pale and deeply excavated, its floor a chalky greyish-white pitted with fine laminar pores and ringed by only a thin remaining band of healthy pink-orange neuroretinal rim, the vessels kinking sharply as they dive over the steep cup edge: the unmistakable high cup-to-disc ratio of a glaucomatous optic disc. Softly out of focus at one side, a Singaporean ophthalmic technician leans in, studying the enlarged pale cup with calm, attentive focus under bright, even clinic light.
neuro_strabismus: A close, warm portrait of a young Indian Singaporean woman patient with a pronounced, unmistakable convergent squint: her right eye fixes straight ahead while her left eye is turned markedly and obviously inward toward her nose, both eyes fully visible so the large-angle eye misalignment reads at a single glance. Beside her a Chinese Singaporean orthoptist holds a small opaque black handheld occluder paddle raised just beside the patient's cheek -- poised for the cover test, not covering either eye. BOTH women wear plain solid blue scrubs (one flat blue, no pink, no trim, no piping, no badge, no lanyard), under bright clean even clinic light, the crossed-eye strabismus the sharp unmistakable focal point.
systemic_disease: A single large circular retinal fundus view fills almost the entire frame -- a warm orange-red retina with a pale glowing optic disc off to one side and dark red branching arteries and veins radiating outward, its surface unmistakably scattered with small dark round dot-and-blot haemorrhages and several clusters of waxy pale-yellow hard exudates, plus a few soft fluffy pale cotton-wool spots, the classic retinal signature of diabetic and hypertensive systemic disease. In the lower corner, small and secondary, a Singaporean Malay ophthalmic technician in plain solid-blue scrubs leans in with a warm focused expression, one hand gesturing toward the fundus.
red_eye: Extreme macro of one wide-open human eye in which the entire white of the eye is flushed a vivid, angry red with a dense, diffuse mesh of dilated fine blood vessels spreading right across the conjunctiva -- most intense toward the outer corners and lid margins and fading gently near the clear, still-visible coloured iris -- while the lower lid rim sits swollen and glassy under a bright brimming film of tears, one tear spilling over onto the cheek. The warm skin framing the eye reads as a young Singaporean Chinese woman, brow faintly tensed with irritation, under bright even clinical lighting that catches every wet, inflamed vessel and the shining tear film.
triage: In a sunlit modern Singapore eye clinic, a Malay woman eye-clinic triage staff member in plain solid blue scrubs leans in attentively across a bright triage counter, one hand gently raised to guide, as she closely gauges the urgency of an anxious elderly Chinese walk-in who presses a palm over a visibly red, watering, distressed eye -- the clear moment of judging how urgent this case is. Directly behind, a softly blurred line of several seated waiting patients -- an Indian man, a young Chinese woman and an older Malay woman -- makes plain that a queue is being sorted by priority, keeping the assessing staff member and the acute red eye as the sharp focal point.
history_taking: A warm young Chinese-Singaporean ophthalmic assistant leans in attentively across a bright clinic desk, pen poised over a blank open notepad, listening closely as an elderly Malay patient seated opposite gestures toward his own eye while describing his symptoms mid-sentence. Their steady eye contact and forward, engaged posture make it unmistakably a spoken question-and-answer history interview; soft natural daylight fills a clean, uncluttered Singapore eye-clinic consultation room, the two figures framed close in the foreground.
distance_va: Down a long, softly lit Singapore eye-clinic testing lane, a large luminous back-lit distance letter acuity chart glows on the far wall as the unmistakable hero of the frame, showing crisp descending rows of bold black optotypes that shrink from one big shape at the top to tiny marks at the bottom, rendered as clean abstract geometric glyphs that never spell a readable word. Seen from just behind and beside an elderly Chinese woman sitting upright in the testing chair, one eye covered by a black handheld occluder paddle as she looks steadily down the room at the chart, while a young Malay ophthalmic assistant in plain blue scrubs stands warmly at her side lightly steadying the paddle. Calm clinical daylight with a shallow depth of field keeps the glowing letter chart razor-sharp while the foreground softens.
near_vision: A warm, unposed close-up of a Singaporean patient seated in soft bright daylight, holding a small white handheld reading card at a comfortable near reading distance of about a forearm's length and gazing down at it intently as if reading; the card is filled with several neat left-aligned lines of tiny graduated grey print that step down in size row by row -- largest at the top, shrinking to the finest print at the bottom like paragraphs of reading text -- unmistakably a near-vision reading test, with the card sharply in focus and dominating the frame. Beside the patient a Singaporean allied-health eye-care assistant of a different ethnicity leans in encouragingly in plain solid blue attire, amid clean, airy clinic tones.
pinhole: Tight close-up of a young Indian eye-care technician in plain blue scrubs holding a matte-black, opaque occluder disc perforated with a dense, unmistakable cluster of tiny pinholes directly over the right eye of a calm elderly Chinese woman seated at a vision-testing chair, her left eye gently covered by her own cupped palm as she peers through the little holes toward a distant point beyond the frame. The perforated black disc fills and dominates the composition, crisp and sharply lit, its regular array of small holes -- and a glimpse of the patient's focused eye behind them -- rendered in razor-sharp detail against warm, even clinic light in a clean, bright interior.
iop_nct: A young Malay woman leans in with her chin and forehead pressed firmly to the padded rest of a compact non-contact air-puff tonometer, her eye held wide open as the instrument's short forward-projecting air nozzle aims straight at her cornea and casts a soft blue alignment glow across her iris. A warm Chinese Singaporean eye technician seated at the instrument steadies the joystick to hold the delicate nozzle-to-eye alignment, while bright clean clinic light and razor-tight focus keep the glowing air nozzle and the wide-open eye the unmistakable hero of the frame. Portrait framing.
eye_drops: Tight vertical close-up of a gloved clinician gently pulling a patient's lower eyelid down and away with one fingertip to open the glistening pink conjunctival pocket of the lower fornix, while the other gloved hand holds a small clear plastic eye-drop bottle tip-down just above the eye without touching the lashes. A single clear droplet is caught mid-fall in sharp focus, suspended just above the exposed lower lid, the patient's eye rolled softly upward and away from the dropper tip. The patient is a Singaporean adult with warm natural skin tones under clean bright clinical lighting, the clinician's forearm in plain solid blue scrubs filling the edge of the frame.
pupil_dilation: An extreme macro close-up of a single human eye whose pupil is dramatically and widely dilated into a large, glossy jet-black disc with a crisp circular margin, unmistakably enlarged as after mydriatic dilating drops. Surrounding it a bold ring of richly detailed warm deep-brown iris shows fine radiating fibres, delicate crypts and subtle furrows, with the black pupil rendered distinctly darker than the brown iris so the dilation reads instantly even against a dark eye. Bright clinical examination light casts a soft crisp catchlight, dewy natural lashes and smooth skin framing the lower edge, the oversized round pupil dominating the portrait frame.
colour_vision: A warm, brightly lit close-up of a Singaporean eye-care technician's hand holding up a round Ishihara pseudoisochromatic colour-vision test plate so it dominates the frame -- a dense circular mosaic of countless small dots in rose-pink, salmon, coral, ochre-tan, olive and moss green, with a hidden dotted figure emerging softly from the classic red-green speckled pattern in the unmistakable Ishihara look. Behind the plate, a gently blurred Singapore eye clinic with a warmly lit multi-ethnic patient (Chinese, Malay or Indian) seated ready for testing, natural soft daylight, crisp and bright.
amsler_macula: Warm, bright close-up of an elderly Chinese Singaporean woman seated at reading distance, holding up a white card whose printed face is turned squarely toward the viewer, filling and dominating the sharp foreground: a crisp, perfectly square grid of fine straight black lines with a single bold black dot at its exact centre. She fixates that central dot with one eye while her other hand gently covers the other eye; just behind her a Malay allied-health assistant in plain solid blue leans in and lightly steadies the chart, in an airy Singapore eye-clinic room.
fall_risk: A frail elderly Chinese woman grips a polished wall-mounted handrail with one hand and leans on a walking cane with the other as she takes careful, visibly unsteady steps along a bright Singapore eye-clinic corridor, while a warm young Malay allied-health staff member in plain blue firmly steadies her elbow and forearm and watches her feet with close, protective attention. The sturdy grab-rail, wide non-slip floor, steadying mobility cane, and guarding supportive grip fill the frame in an unmistakable fall-prevention moment, bathed in soft natural window light, warm and reassuring.
perioperative: A calm elderly Chinese patient rests on a wheeled day-surgery trolley in a serene, brightly lit pre-operative eye bay while a warm Malay nurse leans in close and gently secures a clear perforated plastic eye shield over the patient's operative eye, whose brow carries a small inked surgical-site mark. The transparent perforated eye shield fills the foreground, large and unmistakably ophthalmic, as the nurse tucks a soft warming blanket around the reassured patient. Clean, calm, reassuring clinical light, an unmistakably Singapore eye day-surgery preparation moment.
abbreviations: A tight over-the-shoulder view of a Singaporean clinician's hand, pen mid-stroke, charting on an ophthalmic clinical-notes clipboard that fills most of the frame, dominated by two large side-by-side hand-drawn eye circles for the right and left eyes -- each sketched with a simple iris ring, a small central pupil dot, and quick symbolic freehand strokes in the universal eye-clinic charting shorthand. Warm natural daylight in a bright Singapore eye clinic, with a soft, far-out-of-focus Singaporean colleague in plain solid blue behind the hand.
dayward_theatre: A serene, brightly-lit ophthalmic operating theatre dominated by a large surgical microscope with twin binocular eyepieces on a heavy articulated arm, its objective lens angled down close over a single eye -- the sharp focal point of the frame -- where the patient's face and body lie fully covered by crisp sterile pale-blue drapes, only a small fenestrated square opening exposing that one operative eye. Two gowned, gloved and masked theatre staff, one Chinese and one Malay, lean calmly into the microscope's eyepieces, with a sterile-draped tray of fine glinting eye instruments in the soft foreground blur. A clean, professional, unmistakably Singapore multi-ethnic surgical setting.
hvf: A patient sits with their forehead pressed to the forehead rest and chin settled on the chin rest of a large, smooth white hemispherical perimeter bowl that fills and dominates the frame, one eye covered by a plain soft occluder patch while the uncovered eye gazes into the softly glowing centre of the dome; the same patient's hand holds a small coiled-cable response button on their lap, thumb pressing it. Beside the bowl a warm multi-ethnic Singaporean technician in plain solid blue leans in attentively, steadying the patient's head positioning. Bright clean clinical light, shallow focus on the occluded-and-open eyes at the bowl's aperture.
endothelial: In a bright Singapore eye clinic, a Malay male technician steadies a Chinese female patient's chin against a slim non-contact specular microscope, its imaging head hovering an inch from her open eye, while a large display angled toward the viewer fills with a crisp grayscale specular image of the corneal endothelium. That image is the unmistakable focal point and dominates the frame: a dense, sharply outlined honeycomb of tightly packed, near-uniform hexagonal cells, lit by warm, clean clinical light.
oct_macula: A Singaporean Malay woman rests her chin and forehead in the padded rest of an optical coherence tomography scanner while a Chinese technician gently steadies the instrument column beside her; dominating the frame, the scanner's angled display glows with a vivid false-colour macular OCT B-scan -- a horizontal cross-section of smoothly stacked, gently curved retinal layers plunging into a single sharp central foveal depression. Bright, clean Singapore eye-clinic examination room, warm natural light, crisp focus holding both the patient's calm face and the unmistakable layered scan.
oct_rnfl: A young Malay woman technician gently steadies a seated Chinese patient whose chin and forehead rest against the padded bars of a tabletop ophthalmic OCT scanner, both leaning in as a fine blue alignment beam meets the patient's eye. The angled operator display beside them glows with a vivid circular peripapillary nerve-fibre scan -- a bright colour-coded ring orbiting the pale round optic-nerve head, above a matching cross-sectional trace of the layered retina. Bright, warm daylight from a clinic window, plain solid-blue scrubs, clean modern Singapore teaching-clinic mood.
gvf: A large hemispheric matte-white examination bowl fills the frame, with a young multi-ethnic Singaporean patient leaning into the chin-and-forehead rest, one eye fixating steadily on the small central target inside the smooth concave dome; behind the bowl a warm Malay woman examiner in plain solid blue leans in, both hands guiding the black pantograph projection arm that swings a tiny bright spot of light across the interior. Bright, clean, professional eye-clinic lighting; the round bowl, chin-rest and pantograph arm dominate for instant recognition.
ascan_biometry: Extreme close-up of a slim, pen-shaped handheld contact ultrasound probe, its fine rounded tip resting delicately at the exact centre of a wide-open human eye, lightly touching the glistening cornea while gloved fingertips hold the eyelids gently apart. A warm, focused Singaporean eye technician in plain solid blue scrubs leans in and steadies the probe with a precise pinch grip as the reclined multi-ethnic patient fixates upward, calm and still. Bright, clean clinical light with shallow focus on the tiny point of contact where probe meets cornea.
optical_biometry: A Malay woman patient settles her chin and forehead into the head-rest of a compact tabletop non-contact optical biometer, gazing straight into its round measurement optics where a soft focused fixation dot glows to align her eye for axial-length and lens-power measurement; a Chinese technician in plain solid-blue scrubs leans in from the side, one hand resting on the instrument's joystick as the machine's optics cast a gentle glow across the patient's eye. Bright, clean, warm Singapore eye-clinic lighting, sharp focus on the eye meeting the glowing biometer target, portrait framing.
asoct: In a bright Singapore eye clinic, a young Chinese patient rests her chin and forehead against the padded bracket of a dedicated anterior-segment OCT scanner while an Indian technician in plain blue leans in to align the optics; the instrument's large angled display dominates the frame, glowing with a crisp grayscale cross-section of the front of the eye -- a luminous curved corneal arc arching over the dark anterior chamber, the iris and the sharp iridocorneal drainage angle profiled in section where they meet. Warm natural daylight, shallow focus keeping the sectional scan and the scanner's lens head unmistakably sharp.
flare: A compact laser flare-meter optic head mounted on a chin-and-forehead rest is aimed squarely at a seated patient's eye, its fine focused beam entering the front of the eye to gauge anterior-chamber inflammation while the technician's hand steadies the joystick to hold the aim. A Singaporean-Chinese ophthalmic technician in plain solid-blue scrubs leans to the instrument as a Malay patient rests chin on the pad, both faces warm and intent, in a bright clean examination room with the small laser head and its beam dominating the foreground.
corneal_topography: Extreme tight portrait of an Ophthalmic Technician leaning a young Malay woman's chin into a Placido-disc corneal topographer, its illuminated bowl of bright concentric white rings mirror-reflected as a crisp bullseye of glowing rings on her wide-open cornea. The dazzling ringed reflection floats over the dark pupil and glistening tear film, sharply in focus and dominating the frame, while soft clinic light warms the multi-ethnic Singapore scene.
pam: An elderly Malay Singaporean woman sits at a slit-lamp biomicroscope with her chin and forehead settled on its rest, peering INTO a small boxy projector attachment that is clamped onto the slit-lamp illumination arm and aimed straight into her eye -- a Potential Acuity Meter head that projects a tiny vision target through her pupil onto the retina. Opposite her a young Chinese Singaporean clinician in plain solid blue sits at the slit-lamp with both hands on its joystick, looking through the binocular eyepieces toward the patient eye. The compact projector box mounted on the slit-lamp arm and the patient actively looking into its small round aperture are the sharp focal point -- unmistakably an instrument projecting a vision target into the eye, not a plain slit-lamp examination. Bright clean clinic light, warm and unposed.
hrt: A Singapore eye-clinic technician leans in beside a seated patient whose chin and forehead rest against a large plain unbranded BENCHTOP confocal scanning-laser tomographer that images the optic nerve head, the patient looking INTO the tabletop instrument -- no handheld device anywhere, and no lettering, model name or writing anywhere on the machine. On the monitor angled toward the viewer glows a confocal image of the OPTIC NERVE HEAD: a green round optic disc set among fine retinal vessels, ringed by a fine contour outline around its central cup and overlaid with a raised relief map of the cup and neuroretinal rim in red, green and blue stereometric height bands -- an optic-disc topography map. Multi-ethnic Singaporean staff and patient in plain solid blue scrubs, warm bright clinic light, the disc topography map the sharp focal point.
orthoptics: A young Malay orthoptist leans in close to a seated elderly Chinese patient, holding a solid opaque black occluder paddle over the patient's left eye while positioning a clear graduated prism bar -- a vertical strip of stacked transparent prism wedges -- directly in front of the right eye to measure ocular alignment. Bright airy clinic light, warm focused expressions, the occluder paddle and glinting prism bar filling the centre of the frame at eye level.
auto_refraction: A warm, tight portrait of an elderly Malay woman resting her chin and pressing her forehead into the padded rests of a large boxy tabletop autorefractor-keratometer, gazing into its round eyepiece where a soft glowing fixation target -- a tiny illuminated little house at the end of a bright receding tunnel -- pulls her eye forward. On the far side of the bulky measuring head a young Chinese technician in plain solid blue leans in, one hand on the alignment joystick, watching the patient's cornea. Bright, clean examination-lane light; the instrument's chinrest-and-forehead measuring head fills and dominates the frame.
aberrometry: A patient rests their chin and forehead against a sleek wavefront aberrometer while a warm multi-ethnic Singaporean technician gently guides the instrument's alignment toward the patient's open eye; the machine's angled display glows with a vivid circular wavefront aberration map -- a smooth topographic disc of concentric rainbow contours in reds, oranges, greens and blues radiating from the centre. Bright, crisp clinic lighting keeps the colourful circular map the sharpest, most eye-catching element in the frame, with the instrument's optics aimed squarely at the patient's eye.
lens_meter: A close, brightly-lit view of a lensmeter (focimeter): a pair of spectacles rests on the instrument's chrome stage with one lens clamped firmly under the spring lens-holder against the round aperture, while a warm, unposed young Malay ophthalmic technician in plain solid blue scrubs leans into the angled eyepiece, one hand turning the focusing wheel. Through the eyepiece a crisp illuminated green cross-line target glows sharply. Shallow depth of field isolates the clamped spectacle lens on the polished lens table, bright clean Singapore eye-clinic lighting.
retinal_imaging: A young Malay patient sits with chin settled on the rest and forehead pressed to the bar of a tabletop fundus camera, eyes wide toward the lens at the exact instant a brilliant blue-white flash fires; beside them a Chinese technician in plain solid blue scrubs leans to the joystick, and the angled monitor glows with a vivid orange-red circular retinal image showing the bright optic disc and branching blood vessels. Bright, warm Singapore eye-clinic light, shallow depth of field on the glowing fundus image.
dr_grading: A large high-resolution grading monitor fills the frame, displaying a vivid orange-red retinal fundus image of diabetic retinopathy -- a pale optic disc, branching blood vessels, and scattered across the retina the tell-tale signs: tiny red microaneurysms, blotchy dot-and-blot haemorrhages, and clusters of bright waxy-yellow hard exudates. A multi-ethnic Singaporean eye technician in plain solid-blue scrubs leans in close, one hand gesturing toward a cluster of lesions as she reviews the diseased retina, her focused expression lit by the warm glow of the screen.
